Thank you for applying for Christmas assistance through Help Give Hope.


Unfortunately, we are not able to provide Christmas assistance to your family this year. We know asking for help is not always easy, and we truly appreciate the opportunity to consider your application.


We encourage you to contact one of these organizations as soon as possible to see if additional Christmas assistance may be available:

Crosslines: 417-869-0563

The Salvation Army: 417-862-5509


We sincerely wish you and your family a peaceful and joyful Christmas season.


Warmly,



Help Give Hope
